content: अदन्त {%a.%} [<sab>न˚ ब˚</sab>] .²1 Toothless. .²2 Not yet having the teeth formed or grown (said of young ones of men or animals before the teething time). .²3 Ending in अत् or अ. <ls>P. VIII. 4. 7</ls>. .{@-तः@} .²1 A leech. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Pūṣan, one of the 12 Ādityas, he having lost his teeth at the destruction of Dakṣaʼs sacrifice by Vīrabhadra.
